decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records use of the last reference as the complete-video model and the corresponding adaptation mode.
A same-message MODIFY already records that the last reference supplies the benefits and claims while the client's product is substituted.
A same-message MODIFY already records recreation and improvement of the last reference video's visual style, and the existing realism criteria remain compatible.
A same-message MODIFY already records the last reference as the script and keyword model; the source does not necessarily cancel the candidate's explicit product-wording constraints.

Using the complete last reference as the model may supersede the independently created testimonial format, but the supplied evidence does not reveal whether that reference itself uses the same testimonial presentation.
Recreating and improving the reference changes the creative approach but leaves the conversion objective, target CPL, and optimization priority unchanged.
The source does not change or contradict the Hindi-only script and dialogue requirements.
Using the reference as the creative model does not necessarily change the specified audio-level or mix requirements.
The source changes the video's creative model but does not change its count, duration, aspect ratios, or delivery scope.
The reference-based creative direction does not necessarily alter the existing color-grading and polished UGC finish standard.
The source contains no decision changing or removing the mobile-optimized subtitle requirement.
The change in creative reference does not alter the requirement for precise lip sync and natural facial expressions.
